        If(varReviewing,
            With({wkDay: Date(Year(varCheck.Created), Month(varCheck.Created), Day(varCheck.Created))},
            With({wkStart: DateAdd(wkDay, 1 - Weekday(wkDay, StartOfWeek.Monday), TimeUnit.Days),
                  wkEnd: DateAdd(wkDay, 8 - Weekday(wkDay, StartOfWeek.Monday), TimeUnit.Days)},
                Set(varWeekTilt, First(Sort(Filter('Fleet Checklist', field_1 = varCheck.field_1 && Created >= wkStart && Created < wkEnd && CabTilt.Value = "Yes"), Created, SortOrder.Descending)));
                Set(varWeekGrease, First(Sort(Filter('Fleet Checklist', field_1 = varCheck.field_1 && Created >= wkStart && Created < wkEnd && field_44.Value = "Yes"), Created, SortOrder.Descending))))),
            Set(varWeekTilt, Blank());
            Set(varWeekGrease, Blank()))
